title: Forward transform serialization copy
summary: Recovered the 64-byte thiscall transform copy at VA 0x47d840 as a genuine member method. Sixteen ordered word transfers preserve arbitrary representations and original overlap propagation; no numerical conversion, imports, or other fields are involved.
test_description: Direct original comparison for five patterns including random bits, zero, all ones, and IEEE edge representations. Exhaustive nearby destination offsets cover both overlap directions, self copy, adjacent and disjoint buffers, plus independent unaligned sources. Compare all 256 arena bytes, untouched bytes, an independent forward-word model, and FS head restoration after each original call; setup failure is fatal.
known_limits: Transform component names and wider owning object layouts remain unresolved; only the observed 64-byte representation is modeled.
Valid readable source and writable destination ranges are required; null, inaccessible memory, concurrent access and fault behavior are outside tests.
Portable byte accesses reproduce ordinary memory results but do not promise original dword access atomicity or fault granularity.
No matching-byte claim or full-game serialization claim.
